[list][*][b]How it works[/b][/list]
Individuals, or a team of individuals, will have 45 days (1.5 month) from today until [b]April 27th, 2018[/b] to create, test and upload their Purple Time Rift to the Steam Workshop with the tag "2018 Purple Time Rift Mapping Contest" (the mod manager will allow you to set this tag).

After the deadline date, the top 20 highest voted contest entries will be reviewed by Gears for Breakfast staff, and the top 3 maps splitting the cash price. If the maps are seen as suitable for A Hat in Time, we'll also contact the makers about potentially including them in A Hat in Time for everyone to play!

1st place: $500 USD
2nd place: $350 USD
3rd place: $150 USD

The contest is open to anyone interested in modding and level design. Submissions will be accepted until MIDNIGHT (UTC) on April 27th, 2018.

An update to A Hat in Time has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart A Hat in Time. This is a minor update. The changes include:

[list]
[*]Resolved issues with the camera where it would on occasion flip out while in tight corridors
[*]Fixed some regional PS4 controllers not being recognized by the game

[h1]Note on Modding Support BETA[/h1]
We have an opt-in beta available called the "Modding Support BETA". It is a BETA. It will be broken. It's a test ground for us to test all the various crazy mods that modders will make, and fix those before Modding Support gets merged with the main game.

[h1]Note on update frequency[/h1]
Us at Gears for Breakfast take great pride in the fact that we're able to respond to issues quickly. When someone reports a bug, we often have a fix for it ready to ship in less than a day.
However, we did not take into account the fact that a lot of people are on limited bandwidth. Receiving a 2.6gb update multiple times a week can be frustrating when in that scenario. We realize this now, and going forward we will reduce the frequency at which we update, and instead bundle our fixes into major releases instead (or supply the fixes via the Modding Support BETA). The only exception to this will be necessary hotfixes for severe issues. Thank you for voicing your thoughts to us so we can continue to improve the game and our distribution of the game!

Stay cute!!

The only exception to this will be necessary hotfixes for severe issues. Thank you for voicing your thoughts to us so we can continue to improve the game and our distribution of the game!

Stay cute!!

[h1]Gamescom Announcement: A Hat in Time releasing October 5th for Windows and Mac![/h1]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/032/677/218c34ba5fe8a62ed65adc51a40a737b_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1503488467&auto=format&lossless=true&s=7db9ab58e535e762d1209a22e81b56fc[/img]

[h1]A HAT IN TIME RELEASES OCTOBER 5TH[/h1]
Hello backers and slacker-backers, and all the fans who have met us at Gamescom so far!
We're happy to announce that A Hat in Time is releasing [b]October 5th for PC (Steam, Humble, GoG), Xbox One and PS4[/b]! The wait is finally over, the cute-as-heck 3D platformer will be in your hands soon!!
[h1]THE POWER OF MODS[/h1]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/035/997/a1f0ab9ad9c875a3f863477f10a4bf09_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1503505396&auto=format&lossless=true&s=03e6c63475627452aa67d1d160d7cac7[/img]
It is no secret that us at Gears for Breakfast all come from a modding background! It's really close to our heart, and for that reason we've always wanted to return the favor, by allowing our community to mod our game as well!

A Hat in Time will release with the following modding support:
[list][*]✅ Full level editor[/*][*]✅ Full script access[/*][*]✅ Full Steam Workshop support[/*][*]✅ Add a hat[/*][*]✅ Add two hats[/*][*]✅ Add a lot of hats[/*][*]✅ Add new chapters[/*][*]✅ Add new enemies[/*][*]✅ Make a game inside a game[/*][*]✅ Make a game inside a game, that is inside a game[/*][*]✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ EVERYTHING[/*][/list]
Seriously, just go nuts! We love seeing fan creations!!

To kick off our modding support, we'll be releasing OFFICIAL MODS. We've gotten in touch with some VERY COOL people at various studios, and we're happy to announce the following mods will be available for A Hat in Time on PC at launch:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/032/080/e2d60e7b93aeffb2d38aea2343b7a29b_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1503483900&auto=format&lossless=true&s=6b18a8971c3a5ea4a2568599e2369739[/img]
[b]FREEDOM PLANET 2: LILAC'S HEADPIECE[/b]

Freedom Planet is all about momentum and speed, and when given the opportunity to work with the GalaxyTrail team, we wanted to transfer that momentum and speed to A Hat in Time also! Presenting: Lilac's Headpiece!
The headpiece allows Hat Kid to perform Lilac's Dragon Cyclone move, with all-new custom animations, effects and voice lines!
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/032/094/7564b3d05870d7ebe9f1c232ad4e7e4a_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1503484040&auto=format&lossless=true&s=e3896010b358428bb905eedf93eecf65[/img]

[b]PSYCHONAUTS 2: RAZ'S PSYCHIC HELMET[/b]
DoubleFine is so cool for letting us do this!!!!!!!!!! It's no secret that A Hat in Time is Psychonauts inspired, so getting the chance to work with the people at DoubleFine has been a dream! Which of Raz's psychic abilities did we pick as the ability for Hat Kid?
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/033/871/dd173ba5c35cc3992c91bcecfbaa6112_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1503495817&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5a74f5489d0a948f52d03aec397a06b2[/img]
You'll find out when the mod releases October 5th!!

[b]AND MANY, MANY MORE MODS![/b]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/032/413/1cd49b94015ec0fd32b279926e2cf3b6_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1503486527&auto=format&lossless=true&s=0d36b711a1d62708599301e04f31f6ee[/img]

[h1]THANK YOU[/h1]
THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR BEING PART OF OUR JOUNEY TO RELEASE!!!!!!!!!! THANK YOU EVERYONE THAT HAS BEEN AT OUR BOOTH AT GAMESCOM!!!!!!!!!!! THANK YOU, THANK YOU, THANK YOU!!!!!!!!!!!!!
